title: JSON: add "Display JSON in raw form"
description:
The JSON dissector support Object+Array+Member... form and compact form, neither of them looks like JSON. Now add "Display JSON in raw form", some of people may like JSON displayed in its own form, that look likes:

![json_raw_form](/uploads/0bb5cd056c895d79db63441a2dffd662/json_raw_form.jpg)
